claude.manifest: Routes each subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider option names. For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com or api.perplexity.ai), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. A config tool opens the plugin's own dialog to change the provider, gateway and scope options. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Claude Code starts.
claude.catalogue: Routes each Claude Code subagent to a Claude model and effort that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider option names. On every Agent call it sends the subagent's task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com or api.perplexity.ai), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The built-in general-purpose and claude agents send a fixed text in place of their description.

omp.manifest: Routes Oh My Pi subagents to the smol, midl or slow model role and a thinking level that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. It sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com or api.perplexity.ai), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description. The scope setting picks the agents: core routes the bundled task agent, extended routes every agent whose model you did not set. A project can set scope, and extended there can raise spend on the midl and slow roles. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process omp starts.
omp.catalogue: Routes each Oh My Pi task subagent to the smol, midl or slow model role and a thinking level that fits its task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. The plugin sends the redacted task text and the agent's description to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com or api.perplexity.ai), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow. The bundled task agent sends a fixed text in place of its description.

openclaw.manifest: Routes OpenClaw subagent spawns to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed sessions_spawn call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the spawn's one-line label, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com or api.perplexity.ai), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow, each with its own key. The spawn of the requesting agent itself sends that agent's description when it has one and a fixed text when it has none. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings. The scope setting picks the spawns: core routes the spawn of the requesting agent itself; extended also routes the spawns of other agents that set no model. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process OpenClaw starts.

hermes.manifest: Routes Hermes Agent delegated tasks to your small, middle or large model and an effort that fits the task, judged by Jev or the decision model the provider setting names. It scores a task even when you set no model, and sets the effort unless you set one. For each routed task it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, and the task's context, shortened to fit, both with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com or api.perplexity.ai), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway settings allow, each with its own key. It sends a fixed text in place of an agent description, and the task's description parameter, masked the same way and cut to 500 characters, when the delegating model sets one. The plugin sets a model only from your small_model, middle_model and large_model settings. A key set as an environment variable is visible to every process Hermes starts.

provider.title: Scoring provider
provider.description: Whose model scores each subagent task: typesafe, openai, google or perplexity.

gateway.title: OpenRouter gateway
gateway.description: How the provider is reached: direct (its own API only), auto (its own API, then OpenRouter), openrouter-first (OpenRouter, then its own API) or openrouter (OpenRouter only).

scope.title: Routing scope
scope.description: Which subagents are routed: core (the default agents only) or extended (also other agents, as the README lists).

models.title: Scoring models
models.description: The scoring model per provider as provider:model entries for typesafe, openai, google or perplexity, such as {typesafe:jev-latest, openai:gpt-6-luna}; a provider with no entry uses its default.

typesafe.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe.description: The plugin sends it to TypeSafe when provider is typesafe and gateway is not openrouter.

openai.title: OpenAI API key
openai.description: The plugin sends it to OpenAI when provider is openai and gateway is not openrouter.

google.title: Google API key
google.description: The plugin sends it to Google when provider is google and gateway is not openrouter.

perplexity.title: Perplexity API key
perplexity.description: The plugin sends it to Perplexity when provider is perplexity and gateway is not openrouter.

openrouter.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter.description: The plugin sends it to OpenRouter when gateway is not direct.

commandContents.provider: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "provider" it asks the person whose model should score subagent calls and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its provider option in the plugin's settings.
commandContents.gateway: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "gateway" it asks the person how OpenRouter should be used for the provider and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its gateway option in the plugin's settings.
commandContents.scope: Call the tool mcp__model-router__config. With no setting it shows the router's settings. With the setting "scope" it asks the person which agent calls the router should route and applies the answer. Pass no value, because the person chooses in the dialog. Show the tool's reply to the person. If the tool is missing, tell the person to open /config, find the model-router plugin, and set its scope option in the plugin's settings.
